newsitem.title: USA: Michigan Legislature passes $700 mln bond bill.
newsitem.headline: Michigan Legislature passes $700 mln bond bill.

text.p: The Michigan Legislature early Friday morning passed a $700 million bond finance capital outlay bill.

The bill, which now heads to the desk of Governor John Engler, would authorize the Michigan State Building Authority to issue lease reveune bonds for a variety of university, community college and general state capital projects, according to state officials.
Tom Saxton, the building authority's executive director, said it would most likely be a couple of years before the agency issued debt for the majority of the projects.

In the meantime, the authority is preparing an approximately $150 million lease revenue bond issue to retire previously issued certificates of participation, Saxton said. Goldman Sachs & Co will be the senior manager for the deal, while co-managers have yet to be selected, he added.
